parameters.help_en: The idempotency parameter. A unique, case-sensitive, 32-character random string used to ensure that the request is completed only once. This prevents duplicate operations caused by multiple retries
parameters.help_zh: 幂等参数，唯一的大小写敏感的 32 位随机字符串。 用于确保请求完成的次数不超过一次，以此避免多次重试带来重复操作的问题
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The type of the generation task. Required. Valid values:
text_to_image: text-to-image
image_to_image: image-to-image
parameters.help_zh:
生成任务类型，必填。当前支持：
text_to_image，文生图
image_to_image，图生图
parameters.name: job_type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the model. Required. Valid values:
Wonder-Image-2.5-Pro
Wonder-Image-2.5-Fast
Wonder-Image-2
qwen-image-3.0
qwen-image-2.0-pro
qwen-image-2.0
wan2.7-image
parameters.help_zh:
模型名称，必填。当前支持：
Wonder-Image-2.5-Pro
Wonder-Image-2.5-Fast
Wonder-Image-2
qwen-image-3.0
qwen-image-2.0-pro
qwen-image-2.0
wan2.7-image
parameters.name: model

parameters.help_zh: 场景，枚举类型，当前仅有 `general`
parameters.name: scene

parameters.help_en:
The task input. Required. A JSON string that contains the following fields:
Prompt: the prompt. String. Required.
Medias: the list of media files. Required when the task type is `image_to_image`. Up to 9 files.
The Media structure contains the following fields: Type, the media type. String. Valid value: image. URL, the download URL of the media file. String. MediaId, the media asset ID. String
parameters.help_zh:
任务输入，必填，Json String，包含：
Prompt，String，必填，提示词
Medias，媒体列表，`image_to_image` 类型时必填，最多9个
Media 结构包含：Type，媒体类型，String，可选 image; URL，媒体下载地址，String；MediaId，媒资Id，String
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en:
The task feature parameters. A JSON string that contains the following fields:
PromptExtend: specifies whether to optimize the prompt. Boolean. Valid values: `true` and `false`.
PromptExtendMode: the prompt optimization mode. Valid values: `direct` (default) and `agent` (supported only for text-to-image). Only the qwen-image-3.0 model supports this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
任务功能参数，Json String
PromptExtend：提示词优化，bool，`true` / `false`
PromptExtendMode：`direct`（默认）；`agent`（文生图支持）；仅
qwen-image-3.0支持
parameters.name: job_parameters

parameters.help_en:
The aspect ratio. Valid values: 16:9 (default), 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, 1:1, and 21:9.
The qwen-image-3.0 model also supports the following values: 4:5, 5:4, 2:3, and 3:2
parameters.name: aspect_ratio

parameters.help_en: The number of images to generate. Valid values: 1 to 4. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 图片数量。取值范围为[1, 4]，默认为1
parameters.name: n

parameters.help_en: The user business data in JSON format
parameters.help_zh: 用户业务数据，json 格式
parameters.name: user_data
